DECLARE
 HASHING RAW(50);
 PASWD VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 
if :global.cac_dbase ='N' AND :cac.cn is null 
 then 
password_message('ENTER DBASE NAME');

GO_ITEM('CAC.CN');

return;
end if; 
IF UPPER(:CAC.CN) !='QLAB' THEN
 PASSWORD_MESSAGE('INVALID CONNECT STR');
 GO_ITEM('CAC.CN');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 RETURN;
END IF;

:global.logon_flag := '1';
:global.accepts:='1';
:global.internal_con :='2';
logon('','');
select distinct(LIFETRAK_PASSWORD) into HASHING from system_users where
 edi_pn_id =:global.edi_pn_id;
 
PASWD:=utl_raw.cast_to_varchar2(HASHING);
synchronize;
cac_audit_log(:global.edi_user_id,PASWD,'DOD Monitoring Acceptance');


 
:dual.un:=:global.edi_user_id;
:dual.pw:=paswd;
 set_item_property('dual.un',required,property_false);
 set_item_property('dual.pw',required,property_false);

 empty_edi;

LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(:global.edi_user_id);
IS_USER_EXPIRED;
get_session;
set_appl_global; -- IM 15
new_form( lower('sysmenu'));


END;

PROCEDURE check_strong_password_age IS

 password_age number:=0;
 password_warn number:=0;
 no_of_days number :=0;
 no_of_days_to_expire number :=0;
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
BEGIN
 
 password_age :=:global.password_age;
 password_warn :=:global.password_warn;
 
if password_age>0 then
begin
 select nvl(trunc(sysdate)-trunc(password_modified_date), password_age+1)
 into no_of_days from system_users where user_id=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;

 if no_of_days>=password_age then

 al_id := Find_Alert('Warn_alert');

 --Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Err: 1615 Password has expired!' ); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Err: 1615 LifeTrak Application Password has expired!' ); 
 else
 --Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Password has expired!' ); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'LifeTrak Application Password has expired!' ); 
 end if;
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 call_form( lower('utupaswd') ,no_hide ,no_replace ,no_query_only);
 select nvl(trunc(sysdate)-trunc(password_modified_date), password_age+1)
 into no_of_days from system_users where user_id=LT_USER_SESSION.GET_USERID;
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 if no_of_days>=password_age then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 else
 if no_of_days_to_expire <= password_warn then
 BEGIN 
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_alert'); 
 --Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Your Password will expire in '||to_char(no_of_days_to_expire)||' days. Do you want to change your password now ?' ); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Your LifeTrak Application Password will expire in '||to_char(no_of_days_to_expire)||' days. Do you want to change your password now ?' ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 call_form( lower('utupaswd') ,no_hide ,no_replace ,no_query_only);
 end if;
 end; 
 end if;
 end if;
 exception when no_data_found then 
 message('Error reading using chapter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
end if;
END;

/* Added on 02/08/2013 SCR 19807;
 -- Simple function to retrieve error message.
 
 -- Used to retrieve AD errors when connected to db and stores them 
 -- in globalvar pkg error variables for later user.
*/

FUNCTION err_msg(err_code_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 CURSOR error_cur IS 
 SELECT error 
 FROM VALID_ERRORS_LAB
 WHERE error_code = err_code_in; 
BEGIN
 l_err_msg := NULL;
 OPEN error_cur;
 FETCH error_cur INTO l_err_msg;
 CLOSE error_cur;
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NULL THEN
 l_err_msg:= 'Err: No error description for error code ' || err_code_in;
 ELSE
 l_err_msg := 'Err:' || err_code_in ||': '|| l_err_msg;
 END IF; 
 
 RETURN l_err_msg;
END err_msg;
